question_text: A 5 kg object is acted on by a net force of 20 N. What is its acceleration?
memory_trick: F=ma means a = F divided by m. Cover 'a' to remember F/m
common_mistake: Students multiply F x m instead of dividing

question_text: Which organelle is known as the powerhouse of the cell?
why_correct: Mitochondria produces ATP through cellular respiration earning the nickname powerhouse
common_mistake: Students confuse mitochondria with chloroplasts. Chloroplasts are only in plant cells.

question_text: What is the formula for the area of a circle?
why_correct: The area of a circle is A = πr² where r is the radius
memory_trick: Think: Area = π × r × r (two r's)
common_mistake: Students confuse area formula with circumference (2πr)

question_text: According to the Law of Demand, when price increases, quantity demanded will:
why_correct: The Law of Demand states there is an inverse relationship between price and quantity demanded
memory_trick: Price UP = Demand DOWN. Think seesaw - one side up other goes down
common_mistake: Many students confuse Demand with Quantity Demanded
